answer: A jury only counts when its members come from different funding paths, so a farm cannot stack the panel with its own clones; a replayed submission then claws back the payout after the fact. Because trust attaches to a task and not an address, a burned account cannot carry its history to a new label; a pigment of borrowed reputation does not transfer. The failure mode is a slow voyage through cheap proxies, and the karst under that plan is the clawback.
